title: PreModor's PowerMod
description: A mod that adds new powers!
body:
# This mod adds new powers!

# What do these do?
## Dash Ability
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e03d98735bb0d088b47fc2816f2f4f59f3dc280_0.webp)
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e11bee1f9f538e5898e3b44de189c7bc30be5a0.png)
  - Gives you a short speedboost
 ## Heal Ability
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65107ac2e32ec2c472d5730c4d4bc49286820891.png)
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66ffa7e8bda089a6d6f1db59cb2c59b18e542211.png)
  - Heals you to full health
 ## Extra Heart
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4081def01aea292d9bbe934895c6893169813697.png)
  ![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b5421d21fb402e834d48f9b665b5d73dd4c4f64.png)
  - Gives you a extra row of hearts
  - Hurts you when used (INSTANT DAMAGE 2)
